title: I Asked the Lord That I Might Grow

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: I asked the Lord that I might grow
In faith, and love, and ev'ry grace

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: Might more of His salvation know
And seek more earnestly His face

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: 'Twas He who taught me thus to pray
And He, I trust, has answered prayer

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: But it has been in such a way
As almost drove me to despair

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: I hoped that in some favored hour
At once He'd answer my request

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: And by His love's constraining pow'r
Subdue my sins, and give me rest

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lines: Instead of this, He made me feel
The hidden evils of my heart
And let the angry pow'rs of hell

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lines: Assault my soul in ev'ry part
Yea, more, with His own hand He seemed
Intent to aggravate my woe

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lines: Crossed all the fair designs I schemed
Blasted my gourds, and laid me low

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lines: Lord, why is this? I, trembling, cried
Wilt thou pursue Thy worm to death?

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lines: 'Tis in this way, the Lord replied
I answer prayer for grace and faith

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lines: These inward trials I employ
From self and pride to set thee free

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lines: And break thy schemes of earthly joy
That thou mayst find thy all in me
